disclaimer: Decision aid only. Inspect the target project's pinned dependencies and current upstream API docs before version-sensitive implementation.

compose-material3.greenfield: preferred for modern Android Material UI

wear-compose-material3.greenfield: preferred for Wear OS Material UI

material-web.greenfield: use only when the maintained component set fits the product; do not assume future component parity

android-views-mdc.greenfield: prefer Compose; use this profile to maintain or migrate existing Views apps

compose-material3.note: Check pinned Material3 version for exact SearchBar/SearchView API.

wear-compose-material3.note: Use Wear-specific patterns; do not copy mobile SearchBar APIs.

flutter-material.note: SearchBar/SearchAnchor are Material widgets; inspect SDK version.

material-web.note: Official Material web guidance/component parity is limited by maintenance mode.

wear-compose-material3.note: Wear navigation differs from phone/tablet navigation.
Text entry is constrained on Wear; prefer platform-appropriate flows.
Use Wear-specific dialogs/overlays; mobile sheets are not a literal mapping.

compose-material3.note: Verify exact carousel API in the pinned version.

wear-compose-material3.note: Do not import mobile carousel patterns into Wear by default.

flutter-material.note: Use current Flutter Material carousel widgets when supported by the target SDK.

material-web.note: Do not assume official component parity.

wear-compose-material3.note: Wear M3 Expressive is supported, but APIs are Wear-specific.

flutter-material.note: Implement the design principle with Flutter-supported primitives; do not copy Compose APIs.

material-web.note: 2.5.0 ships Expressive token versions; component expansion remains constrained by maintenance mode.
